purpose: Independent free-text witness claims for the M7 text-claim parser (m7_text_claim_parser_v0_1.py / m7_corpus_from_text_claims_v0_1.py). Mirrors corpus/family_tree_verification_claims_v0_1.json's length-1 entries, but each claim is a natural-language French sentence instead of a pre-structured (subject, skeleton, claimed_object) triple -- the LLM must extract the (subject, relation, object) triple from the sentence itself, never told it in advance. 'subject' and 'relation' here are the corpus author's OWN independent record of what each sentence is about (used only to route each text claim to the correct structural candidate and to check the LLM's extracted subject/relation for a genuine parsing-fidelity mismatch -- see m7_corpus_from_text_claims_v0_1.py). 'asserted_object' is the corpus author's independent record of what the sentence literally asserts, used ONLY by the separate golden parsing-accuracy check (scripts/print_text_claim_parsing_accuracy_v0_1.py / its test) -- it is never read by the evidence-building code path, which instead compares the LLM's own extracted object against the real structural prediction (predicted_end), exactly like verdict in the sibling corpus is documentation only and never read by the code path that decides SUPPORT/CHALLENGE.
